source_refs.note: Book p. 292-294: 11.5 Velocity and Acceleration, definitions of v(t) and a(t), Example 6 (conveyor belt) and Example 7 (drone), shown here as Examples 8 and 9.

blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum bachon! Pichhle section 11.4 mein humne seekha ke vector-valued function ka derivative kaise nikalte hain: har component ko alag alag differentiate karte hain. Aaj hum dekhenge ke yeh derivative asal zindagi mein kya matlab rakhta hai. Jab \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) kisi cheez ki position (maqaam) batata hai, to us ka pehla derivative velocity (raftaar aur simt dono) aur doosra derivative acceleration (velocity mein tabdeeli ki sharah) hai. Yani jo calculus aap ne seekha, woh ab ek chalti hui cheez, maslan ek drone ya factory ki belt par rakhe purze, ki harkat ko poori tarah bayan kar dega.

Is section ka naqsha yeh hai: pehle kitab ki do definitions (velocity aur acceleration) parhenge aur samjhenge ke derivative ko velocity kyun kehte hain. Phir speed aur direction of motion ka matlab dekhenge, aur ek aisa qaida seekhenge jis se pata chalta hai ke cheez tez ho rahi hai ya dheemi. Us ke baad kitab ki do misalein: factory ki belt par chalta purza aur pani ke tower ke gird chakkar lagata drone. Har misaal ke baad khud sochne wale sawal hain; unhein zaroor hal kijiye, kyunke Exercise 11.3 mein bilkul yahi kaam karna hai.

Kitab kehti hai: agar \(\mathbf{r}\) kisi particle ka position vector ho jo space mein ek smooth (hamwar, bina tooti) curve par chal raha hai, to \(\frac{d}{dt}\mathbf{r}(t)\) us particle ka velocity vector hai, aur yeh vector curve ka tangent (curve ko sirf ek point par chhoone wali line ki simt mein) hota hai:

blocks.text_alt: d by d t of r of t equals v of t, the velocity vector

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein chhapa hai '\(\frac{d}{dt}\mathbf{r}(t)\) represent the velocity vector'. Subject ek hi cheez hai (ek derivative), is liye sahi angrezi 'represents' hai. Yeh sirf grammar ki ghalti hai; maths par is ka koi asar nahin. Upar hum ne sahi matlab likh diya hai.
Aur velocity vector ka time \(t\) ke lihaz se derivative particle ka acceleration hai, jise \(\mathbf{a}\) se likhte hain:

blocks.text_alt: d by d t of v of t equals a of t, which equals the second derivative of r of t with respect to t

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Derivative velocity kyun hai? Sochiye ek chhote se waqt \(\Delta t\) mein particle \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) se \(\mathbf{r}(t + \Delta t)\) tak pohanch gaya. Farq \(\mathbf{r}(t + \Delta t) - \mathbf{r}(t)\) us ka displacement (jagah ki tabdeeli, simt ke saath) hai. Displacement ko waqt se divide karein to average velocity milti hai. Ab \(\Delta t\) ko zero ki taraf le jayein to bilkul usi lamhe ki velocity milti hai, aur yahi to 11.4 wala derivative hai.
Tangent kyun? Displacement vector path ke do qareebi points ko jorta hai (chord). Jab \(\Delta t \to 0\) hota hai to dono points mil jate hain aur chord tangent ban jati hai. Misaal: gaari mor par ho aur achanak sarak geeli ho to woh seedhi tangent ki simt mein phisalti hai, kyunke usi lamhe us ki velocity usi simt mein thi.
Nikalna kaise hai? Bilkul 11.4 ki tarah: har component ko alag differentiate karein. Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = x(t)\hat{i} + y(t)\hat{j} + z(t)\hat{k}\) ho to
\[\mathbf{v}(t) = x'(t)\hat{i} + y'(t)\hat{j}\]
\[\quad + z'(t)\hat{k}\]
\[\mathbf{a}(t) = x''(t)\hat{i} + y''(t)\hat{j}\]
\[\quad + z''(t)\hat{k}\]
Units ka khayal: agar \(\mathbf{r}\) metres mein aur \(t\) seconds mein ho to \(\mathbf{v}\) m/s mein aur \(\mathbf{a}\) m/s\(^{2}\) mein hoga.

rows: kitni tez aur kis taraf (path ka tangent)
sirf kitni tez, simt ke baghair

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Exercise 11.3 yeh bhi poochti hai ke particle tez ho raha hai ya dheema (speeding up ya slowing down), aur us ka path kis taraf mur raha hai. Is ka qaida (hamara, upar ki definitions se nikalta hai): \(|\mathbf{v}|^{2} = \mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{v}\), to differentiate karne se
\[\dfrac{d}{dt}|\mathbf{v}|^{2} = 2\,\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a}\]
Matlab: agar \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} > 0\) ho to speed barh rahi hai; \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} < 0\) ho to speed ghat rahi hai; aur \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = 0\) ho to us lamhe speed nahin badal rahi.
Misaal: cycle chalate hue agar aap aage ki taraf zor lagayein (acceleration velocity ki simt mein) to cycle tez hoti hai; brake lagayein (acceleration ulti simt mein) to dheemi. Aur agar handle ghumayein (acceleration velocity ke perpendicular) to raftaar wahi rehti hai, sirf simt badalti hai. Isi liye \(\mathbf{a}\) ka woh hissa jo \(\mathbf{v}\) ke aar paar (across) hai, path ko usi taraf morta hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Khud sochiye, phir jawab dekhiye:
(a) Agar kisi particle ka \(\mathbf{v}(t) = 5\,\hat{i}\) har waqt ho to us ka acceleration kya hai aur woh kaisa chal raha hai? Jawab: \(\mathbf{a} = \mathbf{0}\), kyunke constant ka derivative zero hai. Particle seedhi line mein ek jaisi raftaar (5 units per second) se \(x\)-axis ki taraf chal raha hai.
(b) Kya speed kabhi negative ho sakti hai? Jawab: nahin. Speed ek vector ki lambai hai, aur lambai square root se aati hai jo kabhi negative nahin hota. Simt ka hisaab velocity rakhti hai, speed nahin.
(c) Agar \(\mathbf{v}\) aur \(\mathbf{a}\) bilkul ulti simt mein hon to kya ho raha hai? Jawab: \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} < 0\), particle dheema ho raha hai, jaise brake lagi gaari.

Ab dono examples ka naqsha samajh lein, kyunke Exercise 11.3 ke pehle paanch sawal bilkul isi naqshe par chalte hain. Har sawal mein chaar cheezein nikalni hain: (a) velocity, (b) acceleration, (c) speed, (d) direction of motion. Tareeqa hamesha ek jaisa hai: pehle \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) ke har component ko differentiate kar ke \(\mathbf{v}(t)\) banao, phir dobara differentiate kar ke \(\mathbf{a}(t)\). Is ke baad diya hua \(t\) rakho. Phir \(\mathbf{v}\) ki lambai speed hai, aur \(\mathbf{v}\) ko us ki lambai se divide karo to direction. Aakhir mein nateejon ko lafzon mein bayan karo: cheez kis taraf ja rahi hai, kitni tez, aur us par zor (acceleration) kis taraf lag raha hai. Yeh aakhri hissa sirf hisaab nahin, samajh ka imtihaan hai, is liye ise kabhi mat chhoriye.

blocks.text: Kitab is section ki do misaalon ko Example 6 aur Example 7 likhti hai. Unit 11 mein kitab ki numbering Section 11.2 mein dobara Example 1 se shuru ho jati hai (11.1.3 ke Examples 1 aur 2 ke baad), is liye number 1 aur 2 do do dafa aate hain. Is portal par Unit 11 ki saari misalein ek hi silsile mein ginti ki gayi hain, is liye kitab ka Example 6 yahan Example 8 hai aur Example 7 yahan Example 9.

blocks.title: Example 8
blocks.problem:
Vibrating conveyor belt in a factory sorting system
A small metal part moves on a conveyor belt in a factory. The belt transports the part eastward (x-direction) while simultaneously vibrating sideways (north-south, y-direction) to help sort items into bins. The position of the part at time \(t\) seconds is given by \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3t^{2}\hat{i} + 2\sin t\,\hat{j}\) in meters. At a specific moment, \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) an engineer needs to analyze the part's motion to ensure it enters the correct bin. Hence, find the following quantities at \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
(a) velocity (b) acceleration (c) speed (d) direction of motion.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3t^{2}\hat{i} + 2\sin t\,\hat{j}\) (metres mein), \(t\) seconds mein; lamha \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Maloom karna: \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par velocity, acceleration, speed aur direction of motion.
Tareeqa: velocity position ka pehla derivative hai aur acceleration velocity ka derivative. Speed velocity ki lambai (magnitude) hai aur direction \(\frac{\mathbf{v}}{|\mathbf{v}|}\) wala unit vector. Har component ko alag differentiate karenge (11.4 ki tarah). Pehle general \(t\) ke liye formula banayenge, phir \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) rakhenge.

(a) Velocity: position function ka pehla derivative
\[\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{r}'(t)\]
\[= 6t\,\hat{i} + 2\cos t\,\hat{j}\]
Ab \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) rakhein:
\[\mathbf{v}\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right) = 6\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\hat{i} + 2\cos\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\hat{j}\]
\[= 3\pi\,\hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j}\]
Kyun: \(3t^{2}\) ka derivative power rule se \(6t\), aur \(2\sin t\) ka derivative \(2\cos t\). \(\cos\frac{\pi}{2} = 0\) hai, is liye \(\hat{j}\) wala hissa khatam. Kitab ki tashreeh: is lamhe purza bilkul mashriq (east) ki taraf chal raha hai, north-south mein us ki koi velocity nahin.
Dhyan dein: \(t\) pehle rakh kar phir differentiate na karein; pehle derivative, phir value.

(b) Acceleration: velocity vector ka derivative
\[\mathbf{a}(t) = \mathbf{v}'(t)\]
\[= 6\,\hat{i} - 2\sin t\,\hat{j}\]
\(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par:
\[\mathbf{a}\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right) = 6\,\hat{i} - 2\sin\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\hat{j}\]
\[= 6\,\hat{i} - 2\,\hat{j}\]
Kyun: \(6t\) ka derivative 6, aur \(2\cos t\) ka derivative \(-2\sin t\) (cos ke derivative mein minus aata hai). \(\sin\frac{\pi}{2} = 1\). Kitab kehti hai: purza mashriq ki taraf 6 m/s\(^{2}\) aur junoob (south) ki taraf 2 m/s\(^{2}\) se accelerate kar raha hai; is lamhe us ki north-south velocity zero hai, phir bhi woh south ki taraf chalna shuru kar raha hai.

(c) Speed: velocity vector ki magnitude
\[|\mathbf{v}(t)| = \sqrt{36t^{2} + 4\cos^{2}t}\]
\(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par:
\[\left|\mathbf{v}\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\right|\]
\[= \sqrt{\left(6\cdot\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right)^{2} + \left(2\cos\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right)^{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{(3\pi)^{2} + 0} = 3\pi\]
Kyun: \(a\hat{i} + b\hat{j}\) ki lambai \(\sqrt{a^{2} + b^{2}}\) hoti hai (Pythagoras). \(3\pi \approx 9.42\), yani purza apne raaste par taqreeban 9.42 metre fi second se chal raha hai. Speed scalar hai, is mein simt nahin hoti.

(d) Direction of motion: unit tangent vector
\[\hat{\mathbf{v}}(t) = \dfrac{\mathbf{v}(t)}{|\mathbf{v}(t)|}\]
\(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par:
\[\hat{\mathbf{v}}\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right) = \dfrac{3\pi\,\hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j}}{3\pi}\]
\[= \hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j}\]
Kyun: kisi vector ko us ki apni lambai se divide karein to simt wahi rehti hai magar lambai 1 ho jati hai. Simt seedhi mashriq (positive \(x\)-direction) hai: purze ki north-south jhool (oscillation) is lamhe ruki hui hai aur woh sirf belt ke saath seedha chal raha hai.

Tasdeeq:
\(\hat{\mathbf{v}}\) ki lambai \(\sqrt{1^{2} + 0^{2}} = 1\) hai, aur speed positive hai. Hamari taraf se ek aur check (kitab mein nahin):
\[\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = (3\pi)(6) + (0)(-2) = 18\pi\]
Yeh positive hai, is liye is lamhe purza tez ho raha hai (speeding up). Aur north-south velocity \(2\cos t\) \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) se zara pehle positive aur zara baad negative hai, yani purza waqai south ki taraf mudna shuru kar raha hai, jaisa kitab ne kaha.
blocks.answer: \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par: (a) \(\mathbf{v} = 3\pi\,\hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j}\) m/s; (b) \(\mathbf{a} = 6\,\hat{i} - 2\,\hat{j}\) m/s\(^{2}\); (c) speed \(= 3\pi \approx 9.42\) m/s; (d) direction \(\hat{\mathbf{v}} = \hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j}\), seedha mashriq (due east).

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Khud sochiye: Example 8 mein \(t = 0\) par purze ki velocity aur speed kya hai? Jawab: \(\mathbf{v}(0) = 6(0)\hat{i} + 2\cos 0\,\hat{j} = 0\,\hat{i} + 2\,\hat{j}\), speed 2 m/s. Yani shuru mein purza sirf shimaal (north) ki taraf hil raha hai, mashriq ki taraf us ki velocity abhi zero hai.
Signs ko samajhna: positive \(y\) shimaal hai, is liye \(\hat{j}\) ka negative hissa junoob. Acceleration \(-2\,\hat{j}\) junoob ki taraf hai jab ke north-south velocity zero hai; agle lamhe yeh velocity negative ho jati hai. Bilkul jhoole ki tarah: sab se ooncha point par jhoola ek lamha rukta hai, lekin us ka acceleration pehle hi wapas ki taraf hota hai.
Yaad rakhein: speed \(|\mathbf{v}|\) hai, \(|\mathbf{r}|\) nahin. \(|\mathbf{r}|\) to origin se faasla hai, bilkul alag cheez.

blocks.title: Example 9
blocks.problem:
Drone inspecting a cylindrical water tower
A drone is programmed to fly in a helical (spiral) path around a large cylindrical water tower to inspect its outer surface for cracks or rust. The drone maintains a constant horizontal distance of 2 meters from the tower's center while climbing upward at a steady rate. The drone's position in 3D space at time \(t\) seconds is given by: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\cos t\,\hat{i} + 2\sin t\,\hat{j} + 3t\,\hat{k}\)
Here:
\(x(t) = 2\cos t\): east-west position (amplitude 2 m)
\(y(t) = 2\sin t\): north-south position (amplitude 2 m)
\(z(t) = 3t\): vertical height (climbs 3 m/s)
At a specific moment \(t = \pi\) seconds, the drone operator needs to analyze its motion to ensure smooth inspection. Find the following quantities at \(t = \pi\): (a) velocity, (b) acceleration, (c) speed, and (d) direction of motion at \(t = \pi\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\cos t\,\hat{i} + 2\sin t\,\hat{j} + 3t\,\hat{k}\) (metres mein), \(t\) seconds mein; lamha \(t = \pi\). North-south component \(y(t) = 2\sin t\) hai (neeche kitab ki ghalti dekhiye).
Maloom karna: \(t = \pi\) par velocity, acceleration, speed aur direction of motion.
Tareeqa: har component ko ek dafa differentiate kar ke \(\mathbf{v}\), doosri dafa \(\mathbf{a}\). Speed \(= |\mathbf{v}|\), direction \(= \frac{\mathbf{v}}{|\mathbf{v}|}\). Phir \(t = \pi\) rakhenge; yaad rakhein \(\sin\pi = 0\) aur \(\cos\pi = -1\).

(a) Velocity: har component ka pehla derivative
\[\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{r}'(t)\]
\[= -2\sin t\,\hat{i} + 2\cos t\,\hat{j} + 3\,\hat{k}\]
\(t = \pi\) par:
\[\mathbf{v}(\pi) = -2\sin\pi\,\hat{i} + 2\cos\pi\,\hat{j} + 3\,\hat{k}\]
\[= 0\,\hat{i} - 2\,\hat{j} + 3\,\hat{k}\]
Kyun: \(\cos t\) ka derivative \(-\sin t\), \(\sin t\) ka \(\cos t\), aur \(3t\) ka 3. Matlab: is lamhe drone ki east-west harkat zero hai, woh south ki taraf 2 m/s se ja raha hai aur 3 m/s se upar charh raha hai.
Dhyan dein: \(2\cos\pi = 2(-1) = -2\); yahan sign ki ghalti bohat aam hai.

(b) Acceleration: doosra derivative
\[\mathbf{a}(t) = \mathbf{v}'(t)\]
\[= -2\cos t\,\hat{i} - 2\sin t\,\hat{j} + 0\,\hat{k}\]
\(t = \pi\) par:
\[\mathbf{a}(\pi) = -2\cos\pi\,\hat{i} - 2\sin\pi\,\hat{j} + 0\,\hat{k}\]
\[= 2\,\hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j} + 0\,\hat{k}\]
Kyun: constant 3 ka derivative zero, aur \(-2\cos\pi = -2(-1) = 2\). Drone mashriq ki taraf 2 m/s\(^{2}\) se accelerate kar raha hai. \(t = \pi\) par drone \((-2, 0, 3\pi)\) par hai, yani tower ke axis (\(z\)-axis) se maghrib (west) mein. To \(2\,\hat{i}\) drone se seedha axis ki taraf ishara karta hai. Isay centripetal acceleration (markaz ki taraf acceleration) kehte hain, aur yahi drone ko gol (circular) raaste par rakhta hai.

(c) Speed: velocity ki magnitude
\[|\mathbf{v}(t)| = \sqrt{4\sin^{2}t + 4\cos^{2}t + 9}\]
\[= \sqrt{4 + 9} = \sqrt{13}\]
\(t = \pi\) par:
\[|\mathbf{v}(\pi)| = \sqrt{13} \approx 3.6056 \text{ m/s}\]
Kyun: \(\sin^{2}t + \cos^{2}t = 1\), is liye \(t\) speed mein se ghaib ho gaya. Matlab drone ki speed poori charhai mein ek jaisi, taqreeban 3.61 m/s, rehti hai, jo saaf aur hamwar video ke liye behtareen hai.

(d) Direction of motion: unit tangent vector
\[\hat{\mathbf{v}}(t) = \dfrac{\mathbf{v}(t)}{|\mathbf{v}(t)|}\]
\[= \dfrac{-2\sin t\,\hat{i} + 2\cos t\,\hat{j} + 3\,\hat{k}}{\sqrt{13}}\]
\(t = \pi\) par:
\[\hat{\mathbf{v}}(\pi) = \dfrac{0\,\hat{i} - 2\,\hat{j} + 3\,\hat{k}}{\sqrt{13}}\]
\[= 0\,\hat{i} - \dfrac{2}{\sqrt{13}}\hat{j} + \dfrac{3}{\sqrt{13}}\hat{k}\]
Kyun: velocity ko speed \(\sqrt{13}\) se divide kiya taake lambai 1 ho jaye. Drone south aur upar wale vertical plane mein chal raha hai; us ki simt mein east-west ka koi hissa nahin.

Tasdeeq:
\[|\hat{\mathbf{v}}(\pi)|^{2} = \dfrac{0 + 4 + 9}{13} = 1\]
yani \(\hat{\mathbf{v}}\) waqai unit vector hai. Hamari taraf se: \(\mathbf{v}(\pi)\cdot\mathbf{a}(\pi) = (0)(2) + (-2)(0) + (3)(0) = 0\), to speed nahin badal rahi, jo (c) ke constant speed wale nateeje se milta hai.
blocks.answer: \(t = \pi\) par: (a) \(\mathbf{v} = 0\,\hat{i} - 2\,\hat{j} + 3\,\hat{k}\) m/s; (b) \(\mathbf{a} = 2\,\hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j} + 0\,\hat{k}\) m/s\(^{2}\) (centripetal, tower ke axis ki taraf); (c) speed \(= \sqrt{13} \approx 3.61\) m/s (constant); (d) \(\hat{\mathbf{v}} = 0\,\hat{i} - \frac{2}{\sqrt{13}}\hat{j} + \frac{3}{\sqrt{13}}\hat{k}\).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Drone ke position vector ke neeche wali list mein kitab '\(y(t) = 2\cos t\): north-south position' chhapti hai. Lekin kitab ka apna position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\cos t\,\hat{i} + 2\sin t\,\hat{j} + 3t\,\hat{k}\) hai, to north-south component \(y(t) = 2\sin t\) hona chahiye. Kitab ka hal bhi yahi leta hai (us ki velocity mein \(2\cos t\,\hat{j}\) hai, jo \(2\sin t\) ka derivative hai). Sahi: \(y(t) = 2\sin t\): north-south position (amplitude 2 m). Upar sawal mein hum ne sahi likh diya hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Drone ka raasta helix (spring jaisa chakkardar raasta) kyun hai? Us ka ufuqi (horizontal) hissa \(x = 2\cos t\), \(y = 2\sin t\) hai, aur \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 4\cos^{2}t + 4\sin^{2}t = 4\). Yani upar se dekhein to drone 2 m radius ke circle par ghoom raha hai. Saath saath us ki oonchai \(z = 3t\) barabar barh rahi hai. Ghoomte hue upar charhna, bilkul screw ke chakkar (thread) ki tarah.
Centripetal acceleration ki miqdaar bhi check kar lein (hamari taraf se): horizontal speed \(\sqrt{4\sin^{2}t + 4\cos^{2}t} = 2\) m/s aur radius 2 m hai, to \(\frac{(\text{speed})^{2}}{\text{radius}} = \frac{4}{2} = 2\) m/s\(^{2}\), bilkul \(|\mathbf{a}(\pi)|\) ke barabar. Physics wala formula aur calculus wala jawab ek ho gaye.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Khud sochiye: Example 9 mein \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par drone ki velocity kya hogi, aur kya speed phir bhi \(\sqrt{13}\) hogi?
Jawab: \(\mathbf{v}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = -2\sin\frac{\pi}{2}\,\hat{i} + 2\cos\frac{\pi}{2}\,\hat{j} + 3\,\hat{k} = -2\,\hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j} + 3\,\hat{k}\). Yani is lamhe drone maghrib (west) ki taraf ja raha hai aur upar charh raha hai. Speed \(\sqrt{4 + 0 + 9} = \sqrt{13}\), wohi. Simt badal gayi magar raftaar wahi rahi; yahi constant speed ka matlab hai.
Ek aur sawal: kya drone ka acceleration kabhi upar ki taraf hota hai? Jawab: nahin, \(\mathbf{a}(t)\) ka \(\hat{k}\) wala hissa hamesha zero hai, kyunke oonchai \(3t\) ek jaisi raftaar se barh rahi hai. Upar ki raftaar badal nahin rahi, to upar ki taraf koi acceleration nahin.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Hamari taraf se ek chhoti misaal (kitab ki nahin): \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\hat{i} + 4t\,\hat{j}\) ke liye \(t = 1\) par sab kuch nikaliye.
Velocity: \(\mathbf{v}(t) = 2t\,\hat{i} + 4\,\hat{j}\), to \(\mathbf{v}(1) = 2\,\hat{i} + 4\,\hat{j}\). Acceleration: \(\mathbf{a}(t) = 2\,\hat{i}\), har waqt ek jaisa. Speed: \(|\mathbf{v}(1)| = \sqrt{4 + 16} = \sqrt{20} = 2\sqrt{5}\). Direction: \(\frac{2\hat{i} + 4\hat{j}}{2\sqrt{5}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\hat{i} + \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\hat{j}\).
Tez ho raha hai ya dheema? \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = (2)(2) + (4)(0) = 4 > 0\), to tez ho raha hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Hamari taraf se doosri misaal (kitab ki nahin), jahan cheez dheemi ho rahi hai: ek gend seedhi upar phenki gayi aur us ki position \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2t\,\hat{i} + (10t - 5t^{2})\hat{j}\) hai. \(t = 1.5\) par kya ho raha hai?
Velocity: \(\mathbf{v}(t) = 2\,\hat{i} + (10 - 10t)\hat{j}\), to \(\mathbf{v}(1.5) = 2\,\hat{i} - 5\,\hat{j}\). Acceleration: \(\mathbf{a}(t) = -10\,\hat{j}\), hamesha neeche ki taraf (gravity jaisa).
\(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = (2)(0) + (-5)(-10) = 50 > 0\): gend tez ho rahi hai, kyunke woh ab neeche gir rahi hai aur gravity bhi neeche kheench rahi hai. Lekin \(t = 0.5\) par \(\mathbf{v} = 2\,\hat{i} + 5\,\hat{j}\) aur \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = -50 < 0\): upar jaate hue gend dheemi ho rahi thi. Aur \(t = 1\) par \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = 0\): yahi sab se ooncha point hai, jahan speed sab se kam hoti hai.
Is misaal se yeh baat pakki kar lein: \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a}\) ka sign hi batata hai ke cheez tez ho rahi hai ya dheemi; sirf acceleration ki simt dekh kar faisla na karein.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{r}'(t)\) path ka tangent hai; \(\mathbf{a}(t) = \mathbf{v}'(t) = \mathbf{r}''(t)\). Har component alag differentiate hota hai.
2. Speed \(= |\mathbf{v}(t)|\) scalar hai; direction of motion \(= \frac{\mathbf{v}(t)}{|\mathbf{v}(t)|}\) unit vector hai.
3. Pehle general \(t\) ke liye \(\mathbf{v}(t)\) aur \(\mathbf{a}(t)\) banayein, phir diya hua lamha rakhein.
4. \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} > 0\): tez ho raha hai; \(< 0\): dheema ho raha hai; \(= 0\): us lamhe speed nahin badal rahi.
5. \(\cos t\), \(\sin t\) wali circular ya helical harkat mein speed constant rehti hai aur horizontal acceleration markaz ki taraf (centripetal) hota hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Differentiate karne se pehle \(t\) ki value rakh dena. \(\mathbf{r}(\frac{\pi}{2})\) ek fixed vector hai aur us ka derivative zero aayega; hamesha pehle derivative lein.
2. Calculator degree mode mein: \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) ya \(t = \pi\) radians hain.
3. \(\cos t\) ke derivative ka sign: \(-\sin t\), na ke \(\sin t\).
4. Direction poochi jaye aur velocity hi likh dena: direction ke liye speed se divide karna zaroori hai taake lambai 1 ho.
5. Speed ko \(|\mathbf{r}|\) samajh lena; speed hamesha \(|\mathbf{v}|\) hai.
